item.title: About
item.description: Hello! I am Alessandro. I am a computer engineer and I am pursuing my Master’s degree at PoliMi. I am also the team leader of the software team for the 6s Cubesat Project at PoliSpace. Experiences, Projects and Courses PoliSpace 6S Cubesat - 2022/present Team Leader 09/2023 - present - Technical leader for the Software Subsystem. Design of mission’s mode manager. AOCS module integration. Software Engineer 12/2022 - 8/2023 - Design and testing of the Flight Software for the onboard computer.

item.title: Tmux Setup
item.description: Tmux default configuration didn’t fit well my workflow. This is my tmux configuration: tmux prefix # Set prefix to Ctrl unbind C-b set -g prefix C-a The prefix is a combiantion of key that initiate any tmux command. For this reason it must be confortable to type over and over. The first you learn touch typing (writing without looking at the keyboard) is to always keep you hand on the home row.
